cohort: One hundred boys with primary monosymptomatic nocturnal enuresis (PMNE) and idiopathic hypercalciuria (IHC) were randomly assigned to treatment or control groups.
finding: A single daily dose of hydrochlorothiazide was found to be a safe and effective therapeutic option for primary monosymptomatic nocturnal enuresis in children with idiopathic hypercalciuria.
